name: P523 native packaging and signing preparation checks on committed source (2026-09-23 rerun at desktop 448f4c16)
summary: P523 preparation rerun on committed source: the same 42 papercusp-desktop native Node test files as the 2026-09-22 runs all passed: 545 tests, 545 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled, 0 todo, exit 0. It was repeated because a peer change to bin/release-local.sh and test/release-local-linux-reuse.test.js was committed as desktop 448f4c16 (23:46Z) after the 22:55Z run. That change added the manifest receipt output-digest check and 7 tests, which this run includes (TAP 345 and 346). The runner was invoked as plain `node --test`, the package's own documented form, not through scripts/pc-heavy.sh: the pc-heavy queue had been clamped to one slot, held by live-federation-gate.sh and a gitnexus analyze, for over 9 minutes, and this suite runs at --test-concurrency=1. The tests cover packaging-source behavior using source inspection, temporary fixture repositories and artifacts, and mocked install transports. This is NOT a full installer build, public signing, notarization, real-machine installation, P-521 physical acceptance, or a release-candidate test.

assertions.evidence: The run wrote EXIT=0. The TAP output ended with 1..545, tests 545, pass 545, fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0, todo 0, duration_ms 131010.240339. grep counted 545 'ok' lines and 0 'not ok' lines.

Before and after the run, the snapshot recorded both repo heads, git status over papercusp-desktop bin, test, src-tauri and package.json, and a SHA-256 digest of the 42 test files plus papercusp-desktop/bin/*.sh (bcc3bca002e3b02d4d2b7722773278cfe0c730bbe8844a897b5c3558b3d30113). The two snapshots were byte-identical: superproject head f22392a985e0bf1c3dc54365276b81a77bab84c1 and papercusp-desktop head 448f4c16529188b379786283b5f777bba14b0dd0 both times, with empty git status both times.
185 of the 545 passing tests have refusal-shaped names (refuse, reject, FAIL, corrupt, absent, invalid, missing, denies, block). This is a name-based count, not a mutation proof.
TAP ok 345 - a reused manifest receipt re-verifies its outputs instead of publishing on trust. TAP ok 346 - a reused manifest receipt refuses outputs it did not commit.
TAP ok 48 - refuses to publish a deb when its updater signature is missing. TAP ok 49 - refuses to publish either final path when the staged signature is invalid.

TAP ok 71 - loads the conventional mode-0600 updater key when no signing env is supplied. TAP ok 72 - honors TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH instead of the conventional path. TAP ok 75 - signing-key preflight runs before seed staging and the expensive build.

TAP ok 67 - FAILS when db-sql/ has zero migration files. TAP ok 180 - compatibility requires extraction, intact bytes, and corruption refusal. TAP ok 186 - a passing installed update writes a tag-scoped receipt bound to provenance bytes. TAP ok 188 - Windows refuses a provenance-listed Server span when any disk is absent. TAP ok 205 - macOS refuses a GUI-only transition when the matching Server DMG is absent.

TAP ok 150 - the sidecar provenance receives the immutable build SHA and version. TAP ok 151 - vm-release sidecar reuse rejects provenance that differs from the launcher build SHA. TAP ok 233 - verify-provenance gates build-start dirt, not later cutter mutations. TAP ok 234 - verify-provenance rejects missing or non-boolean gitDirty attestations. TAP ok 235 - verify-provenance rejects missing or malformed release identity.
